svg.title: This is a single finite unitary interaction with blank detector modes, not a concatenation of statistical bounds. Excitation-preserving couplings between a source mode and a detector mode are ordinary beam-splitter or resonant Jaynes–Cummings interactions in the one-excitation sector. Their matrix entries have units ħθj/τ. After the pulse, decoupled detector excitations are the final stable records. No independent samples or erased failure populations are assumed. If the resource is instead the cross-subspace action A = ∫︁∥PFHPR∥dt/ħ, the same norm equations at l= 0 give ̄q ≤(1 −s) sin2(︁min{A, π/2} )︁.
